opening.ko: 1974년 예산 절차에서 동시결의안의 효과를 적용하세요.
opening.en: Apply the effect of a concurrent resolution under the 1974 budget process.

response.speaker: player
response.en: My conclusion from the record is {{blank}}.

choices.ko: 대통령 서명 없이 의회 예산 틀 확정
choices.en: sets the congressional budget framework without presidential signature
takes effect after Supreme Court approval

correct.speaker: npc:1
correct.ko: 대통령 서명 없이 의회의 예산 틀을 설정하고 세출 법안은 별도 절차로 남기세요.
correct.en: Set the congressional budget framework without presidential signature and retain separate appropriations procedures.

incorrect.speaker: npc:0
incorrect.ko: 동시결의안은 의회 내부 예산 틀입니다. 대통령 서명 단계를 추가한 절차도를 수정하세요.
incorrect.en: The concurrent resolution sets the congressional budget framework. Remove the presidential signature step.

evidence.claim: The 1974 budget process uses a concurrent resolution as a congressional framework rather than a law signed by the president.
